title: Client dealer mapping (BOW front end, EMPLOYEE_USER_MAPPINGS_UPLOAD)
purpose: Maps clients to the dealers (employees) who may trade for them; a client may have several dealers (one line each). The dealers are those of the client's authorised person in the dealer register and the firm's dealers for every client (Connections → BOW upload files). BOW's file uploader takes it from 17:30 to 08:00.

columns.name: Client ID
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The client's UCC

columns.name: Employee ID/Dealer Id
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The dealer's BOW dealer ID

linked: Live RMS → Front-office files → BOW uploads (client dealer mapping)
